teaser: Five-thirty, and the stall is already half built before the market opens — crates stacked, prices written twice, flowers turned so the bruised petals face the back. You are a 6, the life path numerology calls the nurturer, crossed with an INTJ, the type built for strategy and competence. The nurturer in you wants the whole market fed and happy; the architect in you wants the stall to run like a system nobody else has to think about. Most mornings those two impulses look identical from the outside. The difference shows later, when someone offers thanks and the next thought has already turned to what went wrong with the display.
